tools.name: paperform_list_forms
tools.description: List the forms in the Paperform account (id, slug, custom_slug, title, url, live, tags, submission_count, space_id, dates), newest first. Search by title, or also by slug/custom_slug with search_fields. Start here to find the slug or id the other tools need. Paperform: GET /forms.

tools.name: paperform_get_form
tools.description: Fetch one form by slug, custom slug or id: title, description, url, live flag, tags, submission_count, space and dates. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}.

tools.name: paperform_list_form_fields
tools.description: List a form's questions (key, title, type, required, custom_key, description, options). The field keys are the keys of a submission's `data` object, so read this to interpret answers. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/fields.

tools.name: paperform_list_submissions
tools.description: List one page of a form's completed submissions, newest first: answers (`data`, keyed by field key — see paperform_list_form_fields), device and UTM info, payment `charge`, generated PDFs and created_at. Page with skip/next_skip or after_id/last_id; filter by date. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}

tools.name: paperform_get_submission
tools.description: Fetch one submission by id, with every answer, device info, payment charge and PDFs. Paperform: GET /submissions/{id}.

tools.name: paperform_list_partial_submissions
tools.description: List one page of a form's partial submissions (someone started the form), newest first: answers so far, last_answered field, dates. Partials that were later completed stay in the list with submitted_at set; only those with submitted_at null are abandoned. Useful for drop-off analysis and follow-ups.

tools.name: paperform_get_partial_submission
tools.description: Fetch one partial submission by id, with the answers given so far. It may have been completed since (submitted_at set); submitted_at null means abandoned. Paperform: GET /partial-submissions/{id}.

tools.name: paperform_list_products
tools.description: List the products sold on a form (SKU, name, price, quantity in stock, sold, minimum/maximum, discountable, images). Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/products.

tools.name: paperform_get_product
tools.description: Fetch one product on a form by SKU: price, quantity in stock, sold count, limits. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/products/{sku}.

tools.name: paperform_list_coupons
tools.description: List a form's coupon codes (code, enabled, target, discountAmount or discountPercentage, expiresAt). Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/coupons.

tools.name: paperform_get_coupon
tools.description: Fetch one coupon on a form by code. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/coupons/{code}.

tools.name: paperform_list_webhooks
tools.description: List the webhooks on a form (id, target_url, triggers: submission / partial_submission, dates). Needs the Business API. Paperform: GET /forms/{slug_or_id}/webhooks.

tools.name: paperform_list_spaces
tools.description: List the account's spaces (folders that group forms): id, name, dates. Needs the Business API. Paperform: GET /spaces.

tools.name: paperform_list_space_forms
tools.description: List the forms in one space. Needs the Business API. Paperform: GET /spaces/{id}/forms.

tools.name: paperform_list_papersign_documents
tools.description: List Papersign e-signature documents (id, name, status, folder, space, signers, variables, source form/submission, sent/completed dates), filtered by name, status, folder, space or the Paperform submission that created them. Needs the Papersign API. Paperform: GET /papersign/documents.

tools.name: paperform_get_papersign_document
tools.description: Fetch one Papersign document by id: status, signers and their progress, variables, folder, space and dates. Needs the Papersign API. Paperform: GET /papersign/documents/{id}.

tools.name: paperform_get_signed_document_url
tools.description: Get a download link for a completed (fully signed) Papersign document as a PDF. A fresh link is made on each call and is valid for one week (expires_at_utc). Needs the Papersign API. Paperform: GET /papersign/documents/{id}/completed-document-url.

tools.name: paperform_list_papersign_folders
tools.description: List Papersign folders (id, name, parent_id, space_id), optionally inside one space or folder. Needs the Papersign API. Paperform: GET /papersign/folders.

tools.name: paperform_list_papersign_spaces
tools.description: List Papersign spaces (id, name, root_folder_id). Needs the Papersign API. Paperform: GET /papersign/spaces.

tools.name: paperform_create_coupon
tools.description: WRITE: create a coupon code on a form, with a fixed discountAmount or a discountPercentage (not both), an optional target (price or subscription) and expiry. Respondents can use it at checkout as soon as it is enabled. Undo: paperform_update_coupon with enabled=false. Paperform: POST /forms/{slug_or

tools.name: paperform_update_coupon
tools.description: WRITE: change a coupon on a form — enable or disable it, change its discount (amount or percentage), target or expiry (null = never expires). Only the fields you pass are sent. Paperform: PUT /forms/{slug_or_id}/coupons/{code}.

tools.name: paperform_set_product_quantity
tools.description: WRITE: set how many units of a form product are available (its stock quantity), e.g. after restocking. Replaces the current value; read it first with paperform_get_product. Not atomic: it overwrites rather than adjusts, so a sale between your read and this write is lost. Paperform: PUT /forms/{slug_

tools.name: paperform_set_product_sold
tools.description: WRITE: set the number of units of a form product recorded as sold (e.g. to correct it after a refund or an offline sale). Replaces the current value; read it first with paperform_get_product. Not atomic: it overwrites rather than adjusts, so a sale between your read and this write is lost. Paperform

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "paperform_get_coupon" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: paperform_list_forms, paperform_get_form, paperform_get_signed_document_url · Private data: paperform_list_papersign_documents, paperform_get_papersign_document, paperform_get_signed_document_url · Public sink: paperform_create_coupon · Destructive: paperform_list_partial_submissions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: paperform_list_forms, paperform_get_form, paperform_get_signed_document_url · Private data: paperform_list_papersign_documents, paperform_get_papersign_document, paperform_get_signed_document_url · Public sink: paperform_create_coupon · Destructive: paperform_list_partial_submissions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
